Estimated-Changed-Lines: 360

## Goal

Move buttons on every card and the card editor dialog.

## Plan

### Files to touch

- `frontend/src/board/CardActions.tsx`, `frontend/src/board/CardActions.test.tsx`
- `frontend/src/board/CardEditor.tsx`, `frontend/src/board/CardEditor.test.tsx`
- `frontend/src/board/BoardView.tsx` (render `CardActions`, open `CardEditor` from a card's title), `BoardView.test.tsx`
- `frontend/src/styles.css`

### Steps

1. `CardActions({board, card, onMove(columnId, position)})`: four buttons with `aria-label` `Move <title> left|right|up|down` (visible text `←`, `→`, `↑`, `↓`), each disabled when `moveTargets(board, card.id)` gives `null` for it, else calling `onMove` with that target.
2. `BoardView`: `onMove` runs `api.moveCard` through `useBoard`'s `run`; an error shows in the board's alert.
3. `CardEditor({board, card, onSave(patch), onDelete(), onClose()})`: a `<dialog open aria-label="Edit card">` (or `role="dialog"` with `aria-label`) with labelled `Title` and `Description` (a textarea) inputs and an `Assignee` `<select>` (`Unassigned` with value `""`, then each member by display name with their id); `Save` builds a `CardPatch` with only the changed fields (`assignee_id: null` for `Unassigned`) and awaits `onSave`, closing on success and showing an `ApiError`'s message in an alert inside the dialog on failure; `Delete card` awaits `onDelete` and closes; `Cancel` closes.
4. `BoardView`: clicking a card's title button opens `CardEditor` for it; `onSave` runs `api.updateCard`, `onDelete` runs `api.deleteCard`, both through `run`.
5. Run `make verify` and make it pass.

### Tests to add

- `CardActions.test.tsx`: names and disabled states for a card at each edge; clicking `Move X right` calls `onMove` with the next column and the same position.
- `CardEditor.test.tsx`: fields prefilled; changing only the title sends `{title}`; choosing `Unassigned` sends `{assignee_id: null}`; choosing a member sends their id; nothing changed sends `{}`; a validation error stays open with the message; `Delete card` and `Cancel`.
- `BoardView.test.tsx`: add: `Move <title> down` posts `/api/cards/{id}/move` with `{column_id, position}` and reloads; opening the editor from the title and saving sends `PATCH /api/cards/{id}`.
